chunks: There will only be a single jerk, and they will gaze,

key_terms.زَجْرَةٌ: A shout, blast, or jerk (referring to the sound of the Trumpet or the sudden awakening)
key_terms.يَنظُرُونَ: They look/gaze (indicating sudden attention and awe)

ai.seo_question: What happens at the single blast of the Trumpet during Resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah As-Saffat is often linked to the concept of *Barzakh* and the sudden awakening of the soul after death, highlighting the immediacy of the Hereafter. The 'single shout' (*Zajratun Wahidah*) is interpreted by scholars like Allamah Tabatabai as the decisive command of God that severs the connection with the worldly life, causing humanity to rise in awe. This emphasizes the transformative power of divine decree in transitioning from the grave to the final judgment.
